name: PushCheck
description: Friend-group accountability app for push-ups. Track your push-ups, challenge your friends, and see who actually shows up. Simple, clean, and built for friend groups.
tagline: Track push-ups. Challenge friends. See who shows up.

offers.description: Free core app. Optional PushCheck Pro is a one-time $6.99 purchase for public groups and challenge seasons. Check the purchase screen for regional pricing.

featureList: Friend group challenges and shared daily goals
Group leaderboards ranked by total reps or streak
Daily push-up tracking with manual check-ins
Current streak, best streak, daily average, and all-time totals
Free core app with no ads or subscriptions
Optional PushCheck Pro for public groups and challenge seasons

targetAudience.audienceType: Friend groups who want accountability for push-ups

about.name: Push-up accountability for friend groups
about.description: PushCheck helps people track push-ups with manual check-ins, shared group goals, leaderboards, and streaks. Start solo or invite friends to a group.

differentiators: Start solo or track with friend groups
Free core features with an optional one-time Pro purchase
Focus on push-up tracking and accountability
useCases: Friend groups who talk about working out but struggle with consistency
Groups that want friendly competition and accountability
People who prefer social motivation over solo tracking
Friend groups looking for a simple, no-BS fitness app
